slice.title: Snowflake Cost Pack CLI
slice.intent: Expose dataForge's snowflakeCost pack through dashForge's existing generate CLI and snapshot packager so a buyer demo for any Snowflake cost story (for example idle-warehouse-waste) is produced by one command as a deterministic SQLite database plus a provenance-labeled JSON snapshot marked synthetic. Scenarios are enumerated from dataForge, unknown scenarios fail closed with exit 2, the recommendation queue columns are preserved, and existing packs keep working.
non_goals: live Snowflake access or new dependencies

smoke.description: runs the Snowflake cost pack slice tests, the snapshot packaging tests, and the dataForge compatibility suite
